formalStatement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → 0 < k → 2 ≤ m → 2 ≤ k → k ≤ n → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → 0 ≤ x i) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i < n → x (i + 1) ≤ x i) → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≥ 1 → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) ≤ (k : ℝ) → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) ≥ 1
sourceProof:
by
  intro m n k x hm hn hk hm2 hk2 hkn hnonneg hmono hsum_m hsum_le
  by_contra hgoal
  have source_step_0 : ¬ ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) ≥ 1) := hgoal
  let t : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)
  let u : ℝ := x k
  have source_step_1 : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact not_le.mp source_step_0
  have hkpos : 1 ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk
  have hdec : ∀ a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ n → x b ≤ x a := by
    intro a b ha hab hbn
    revert hbn
    induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        intro hbn
        exact le_rfl
    | succ b hab ih =>
        intro hbn
        have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := le_trans ha hab
        have hbnlt : b < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hbn
        exact le_trans (hmono b hb1 hbnlt) (ih (le_of_lt hbnlt))
  have source_step_2 : 0 ≤ u ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t) ∧ t < 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, source_step_1⟩
    · dsimp [u]
      exact hnonneg k hkpos hkn
    · intro i hi hik
      constructor
      · dsimp [u]
        exact hdec i k hi hik hkn
      · dsimp [t]
        have h_nonneg_terms : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range k, 0 ≤ x (j + 1) := by
          intro j hj
          have hjlt : j < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
          exact hnonneg (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have hi_mem : i - 1 ∈ Finset.range k := by
          rw [Finset.mem_range]
          omega
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum h_nonneg_terms hi_mem
        simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hi] using hsum
  have hu_lt_one : u < 1 := by
    have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
      have hxu : x k ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 k hkpos le_rfl).2
      simpa [u] using hxu
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_t source_step_1
  have source_step_3 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u ∧ x i < 1 := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := by omega
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hnonneg i hi1 hin
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact hdec k i hkpos (le_of_lt hki) hin
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_u hu_lt_one
    exact ⟨hxi_nonneg, hxi_le_u, hxi_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_4 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hin : i ≤ n := le_trans hik hkn
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hnonneg i hi hin
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).2
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_t source_step_1
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxi_lt_one
    have hpow_le : (x i) ^ (m - 2) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hxnonneg hxi_le_one
    have hm_eq : m = 2 + (m - 2) := by omega
    calc
      (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ (2 + (m - 2)) := by rw [hm_eq]
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 * (x i) ^ (m - 2) := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ (x i) ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le (sq_nonneg (x i))
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 := by ring
  have source_step_5 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → 0 ≤ (x i - u) * (1 - x i) := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hle : u ≤ x i := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).1
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).2
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_t source_step_1
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle) (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxi_lt_one))
  have source_step_6 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ 2 ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hprod := source_step_5 i hi hik
    nlinarith [hprod]
  have source_step_7 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ m ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi hik
    exact le_trans (source_step_4 i hi hik) (source_step_6 i hi hik)
  have source_step_8 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≤
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u + u * x (i + 1))) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have hi_lt : i < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ i + 1 := by omega
    have hik : i + 1 ≤ k := by omega
    exact source_step_7 (i + 1) hi1 hik
  have hsum_expr_eq :

        = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    dsimp [t]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u + u * x (i + 1)))
          = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u)) +
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u)) +
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) - (k : ℝ) * u) +
              u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) := by
              have hconst : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u) = (k : ℝ) * u := by
                rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
                simp
              have hmul : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) =
                    u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) := by
                rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              rw [hconst, hmul]
  have source_step_9 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    exact le_trans source_step_8 (le_of_eq hsum_expr_eq)
  have source_step_10 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n →
      ((x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i) ∧ x i ≤ u ∧ x i < 1 := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hbase := source_step_3 i hki hin
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hbase.1
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := hbase.2.1
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := hbase.2.2
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxi_lt_one
    have hm1_eq : m - 1 = 1 + ((m - 1) - 1) := by omega
    have hpow_le : (x i) ^ ((m - 1) - 1) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hxnonneg hxi_le_one
    have hpow_le_x : (x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i := by
      calc
        (x i) ^ (m - 1) = (x i) ^ (1 + ((m - 1) - 1)) := by rw [hm1_eq]
        _ = (x i) ^ 1 * (x i) ^ ((m - 1) - 1) := by rw [pow_add]
        _ ≤ (x i) * 1 := by
             simpa [pow_one] using (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le hxnonneg)
        _ = x i := by ring
    exact ⟨hpow_le_x, hxi_le_u, hxi_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_11 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n → (x i) ^ m ≤ u * x i := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hbase10 := source_step_10 i hki hin
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := (source_step_3 i hki hin).1
    have hpow_le_u : (x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ u := le_trans hbase10.1 hbase10.2.1
    have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
    calc
      (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ ((m - 1) + 1) := by rw [hm_eq]
      _ = (x i) ^ (m - 1) * x i := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ u * x i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow_le_u hxnonneg
  have source_step_12 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) ≤
        u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
